name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B
summary: The MoE challenger in the same Gated-DeltaNet hybrid generation as 3.8. On bandwidth-limited hardware this is the shape that wins: 3B active parameters per token means 60-100 tok/s territory where a dense 27B manages 20-50.
notes: The official FP8 checkpoint needs a chat-template fix under SGLang.
unsloth's NVFP4 variant is reported to fix tool-calling (+6.7%) and reach 83.8 tok/s on vLLM.
Needs SGLang >=0.5.10 with EAGLE 3/1/4 and both the qwen3 and qwen3_coder parsers.
SGLang mem-fraction 0.80-0.85 for this family, versus 0.95 on 3.8/MTP.
If boot rejects the qwen3_5_moe arch, use lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.15-cu130, the first release with native ModelOpt mixed-precision load and no patch needed.

practical_baseline.rationale: The most accessible reported 4-bit lane: a 32-64 GB Apple Silicon class with its SSD-streaming dependency stated.

released_note: Month of the Hugging Face repo's creation date (retrieved 2026-10-13); the publisher's exact launch day is not recorded here.
